metadata.et0_method: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith Eq. 6, validated against published examples
metadata.split_strategy: GroupShuffleSplit on station|crop|soil_type, plus unseen-station holdout
metadata.disease_labels: SYNTHESISED by the rule engine in artifacts/disease_thresholds.json, not observed. The labels reproduce from six climate and soil features at 100%, so the disease model is a smooth restatement of that table and its scores measure rule memorisation, not disease diagnosis. See backend/ml/tests/test_disease_labels.py. Stress-risk indicator only.
metadata.disease_score_interpretation: Do not present as diagnostic performance. A perfect unseen-station score is a consequence of the labels being deterministic, not evidence of generalisation to real disease.
metadata.decision_score_interpretation: The irrigate score is isotonic-calibrated, so the threshold is an actual event rate. Ranking quality is reported as average precision against the positive rate, because accuracy is 0.979 for a model that could do nothing.

irrigate_decision_global_threshold.model: irrigate_decision (single global operating point, for comparison)

water_depth.conformal_residual_source: out-of-fold over 4 grouped folds of the irrigation-event training rows

water_depth_ood.correction_method: multiplicative factor from the field's observed mean depth over its predicted mean on irrigation events, clipped to [0.5, 2.0]; estimated on a rolling trailing window in service
